q1_issues.issue: The `Time` role is hung on a group witness (`sk_group_1`), but the instruction set defines `Time` only on an event witness or an event-denoting noun, and never gives an entity-side counterpart the way `LocatedIn` counterparts `Location`.

q2_gaps: a bare season name as a time expression ("in the winter") — the structured `Time` terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus day-part symbols, and seasons appear only inside deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer), so a non-deictic "the winter" has no defined form
a temporal adjunct on an existential "there are N Xs" clause that reifies no event — the existential section mints only a witness plus its class atom, leaving no licensed host for the time adjunct
notes: `CardinalityPhrase` with the surface string "a lot of" is the right routing here (the phrase counts things rather than setting a generic proportion). The recurrent/habitual sense of "in the winter" (fires every winter) is also left unmarked, though the sentence lacks the explicit "every" that the frequency section keys on.
